excerpt: metal : spread the short mat-vec lanes over src1 rows The short mat-vec kernel (K < 32) mapped its 32 lanes to 32 src0 rows and handled one src1 row per threadgroup, so with few src0 rows most lanes were idle. It now covers min(ne01, 32) src0 rows of 32/that src1 rows. This is the weighted sum over the depth states of Inkling 2 since #32855 (1-3 src0 rows, K = number of states, 2304 src1 rows). Inkling-2-Mini UD-Q4_K_XL, M5 Max, master -> this PR: pp512 888 -> 1052 t/s, pp2048 771 -> 894 t/s, tg128 unchanged. PPL and greedy output bit-identical, the graph is unchanged. Tested: test-backend-ops -b MTL0 -o MUL_MAT (new small-K cases). cont : clean-up comment
